items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He’s kind of like my French brother ... over the years it’s been a very “brother” kind of feeling with him. To play with him is such a unique experience ... some nice things came out of that collaboration I think.

ctx.x: That’s coming out whenever it comes out on ECM. We recorded it at Birdland last December. From the previous experience I had where we recorded from the Bakery in California with a trio with Charlie. That was the only time we really played together. Once or twice after that. At Birdland after maybe the first evening or after the first set or whatever I suggested to Brad that he “please feel free to orchestrate and do whatever you feel like doing” because he was kind of very respectfully playing around and it was…
Yeah I’d like to hear that. I had Brad as a composition student twenty years ago at the New School so I knew him when.
